annotations.text:
Prayer Times — Xteink X3, 528×792, 1-bit e-ink. Same vocabulary as the Apps screen: Inter 500/700, 45px header, 2px rule, 40px hint bar, inverted selection.
One screen, four buttons. Back · Confirm · Left · Right — the hint bar is the whole affordance, so every state relabels it.

Flow (click the hint bar or the rows):
One settings-style list, same font throughout. Top: date (gregorian left, hijri right), then the six prayers — value '-' until synced. Below the rule: Country, City (appears once a country is picked; its list is that country's cities), Sync Now.
Up/Down moves the cursor over Country / City / Sync Now, Confirm opens. Picking a country resets the city; a new city drops the stored month, so the times go back to '-' and Sync Now still shows the last sync time.
Sync → Wi-Fi pick → fetching (auto) → done → times fill in. Bottom info line: the next-step hint ('Pick a country to get started') until set up, then the source ('Source: Aladhan'); same font as the rows. The countdown sits beside the next prayer's name in its row.
'Custom coordinates' is the first country; its City row shows the lat/lng and opens the editor (Confirm hops Lat→Lng, Up/Down nudges, Back saves).
Calculation method is not on this screen — it lives in Settings → Apps → Prayer Times, next to the app toggle. The 'startState' tweak opens the prototype in any of the three states.

Today, ready: eleven 40px rows in the settings list style, one font size. The next prayer is the inverted row with its countdown beside the name; the cursor only ever sits on Country / City / Sync Now. 'Sync Now' carries the last sync time as its value ('Never' before the first). 11 rows + date + rule ≈ 490px of the 692 available.
Times shown are sample values, not computed.
